description: Upcoming and current estate sales, moving sales and auctions near a US city from EstateSales.NET: per sale the ID, title, sale type, organiser company (website, phone, listing tier), street address when published, ZIP, city, state, coordinates, every sale day with start and end time (UTC and local), picture count and links, plus how many sales the city page lists in total. Related tools on this server, for a different need: realestate_crexi when you need Crexi commercial real estate listings from the JSON search; realestate_loopnet when you need LoopNet commercial real estate listings for a US city. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

city.description: City name, e.g. Austin or San Antonio

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

type.description: Only this sale type, e.g. EstateSales, MovingSales, Auctions (contains match)

name: realestate_estatesales
title: Upcoming and current estate sales, moving sales
